name: Boussole 4C - Questionnaire Design System
description: Design system complet pour le système de questions, réponses et transitions

multiple_choice.description: Questions à choix unique avec options visuelles

ranking.description: Questions de classement par ordre d'importance

questionCard.title: text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4 leading-tight

example.wrapper: flex items-start gap-3 text-slate-500 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-50 to-slate-100 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200

questionCard.footer: flex items-center justify-between pt-6 border-t border-slate-100

option.base: relative p-6 rounded-2xl border-3 transition-all duration-300 text-center group
option.selected: border-teal-500 bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-50 to-cyan-50 shadow-xl shadow-teal-500/30 scale-[1.02]

checkBadge.container: absolute -top-3 -right-3 w-10 h-10 bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-500 to-emerald-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg

validationOverlay.wrapper: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-teal-500/90 rounded-2xl

letterBadge.default: flex-shrink-0 w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-500

bigNumber.number: text-8xl font-black text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-cyan-500

button.base: flex-1 py-3 sm:py-4 rounded-xl text-sm sm:text-base font-bold transition-all duration-200
button.selected: bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-500 to-cyan-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/40 scale-110 z-10

slider.validationBadge: absolute top-0 right-1/4 bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-bold animate-bounce shadow-lg

header.reset: text-sm text-teal-600 hover:text-teal-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1

item.base: flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all text-left

rankBadge.base: flex-shrink-0 w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl transition-all

progress.completeBadge: flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-emerald-500 text-white font-bold shadow-lg animate-bounce

numberInput.decrementButton: w-14 h-14 sm:w-16 sm:h-16 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
numberInput.incrementButton: w-14 h-14 sm:w-16 sm:h-16 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500 hover:bg-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/30
numberInput.input: w-28 sm:w-32 text-center text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black text-teal-600 bg-transparent border-none outline-none

button.base: px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-all

textInput.input: w-full text-center text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-teal-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-teal-100 outline-none transition-all bg-white placeholder:text-slate-300

validateButton.base: flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-cyan-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/30

back.base: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all

next.base: flex items-center gap-2 px-6 sm:px-8 py-4 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all
next.enabled: bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-cyan-500 text-white hover:from-teal-600 hover:to-cyan-600 shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/30 hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-[1.02]

axisTransition.container: min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-8
axisTransition.completeBadge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded-full text-sm font-medium

axisIcon.container: w-24 h-24 mx-auto mb-8 rounded-3xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl

axisTransition.title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-4
axisTransition.startButton: inline-flex items-center gap-3 px-8 sm:px-10 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-white shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transform hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all

introScreen.background: min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-teal-900 relative overflow-hidden
decorativeBlobs: absolute top-[-20%] left-[-10%] w-[600px] h-[600px] bg-teal-500/20 rounded-full blur-[150px] animate-pulse
absolute bottom-[-30%] right-[-10%] w-[700px] h-[700px] bg-cyan-500/15 rounded-full blur-[180px] animate-pulse
introScreen.content: relative z-10 min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4
introScreen.warning: bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/30 rounded-xl p-4 mb-8 text-amber-200 text-sm
introScreen.cta: inline-flex items-center gap-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-cyan-500 hover:from-teal-400 hover:to-cyan-400 text-white font-bold px-10 py-5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl shadow-teal-500/30 hover:shadow-teal-500/50 transform hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all text-xl

header.fixed: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm

cap.label: CAP
cap.description: Votre direction est-elle claire ? Vos équipes comprennent-elles où vous allez ? Mesurez l'alignement stratégique de votre organisation.

contraintes.label: CONTRAINTES
contraintes.description: Qu'est-ce qui vous freine vraiment ? Bureaucratie, culture, conflits... Identifions les blocages invisibles de votre organisation.

capacites.label: CAPACITÉS
capacites.description: Avez-vous les moyens de vos ambitions ? Finances, compétences, outils... Évaluons votre potentiel réel.

cadence.label: CADENCE
cadence.description: Votre rythme est-il soutenable ? Êtes-vous en surchauffe ? Mesurons la santé de votre tempo organisationnel.
